'''Mandalorian battle harnesses''' were a form of vehicle used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. The vehicles were equipped with [[laser]]s and two appendages: a clawing arm and a [[trip hammer]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]], these were used alongside Mandalorian soldiers and [[Basiliskan|Lagartoz War Dragons]] to ambush the [[Dark Underlord]]'s camp during a campaign against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] forces.

One such harness was owned by [[Olag Greck]] sometime around [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]]. Olag forced the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to utilize one in his droid fighting venue on [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]]. R2-D2 smashed [[C-3PX]] while in it, effectively ending the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid's]] operational cycle.
